description: Read a dev session's logs from every context in one timeline, or follow:true for live frames after the replayed ring. Works on a `npx extension dev` run by hand (follow needs --allow-control there); not on extension_start.

browser.description: Session browser; default the live session, else chrome.

followMs.description: ms to collect live frames (500 to 15000).

match.description: Only lines matching this regex or substring.

projectPath.description: Project root of a running session: extension_dev, extension_start, or `npx extension dev|start` by hand

since.description: Only events after this seq (the polling cursor).

url.description: Only events whose url matches (glob or substring).

name: extension_logs
